name: default-7x28
description: The standard Grid: 7 rows tall, 28 columns wide (landscape). 49 modules, each a horizontal 1x4 strip of pixels. Modules are wired in a vertical serpentine (snake): IDs run top-to-bottom down the first column of modules, then the next column runs bottom-to-top, and so on.
_comment_module_grid: The floor is made of modules arranged in a grid. Each module spans 1 row and `pixels_per_module` columns. So a 7x28 pixel floor is a 7-row x 7-column grid of modules (7 * 7 = 49 modules; 7 module-columns * 4 px = 28 px wide).
_comment_snake: How module IDs are assigned across the module grid. 'start' is the corner ID 1 sits in. 'primary_axis' is the direction IDs increment first (before snaking). 'serpentine' means every other line reverses direction.
_comment_pixel_order: Within a single module, which physical pixel is pixel index 0. All modules are mounted identically, so pixel 0 is always the physically left-most pixel and pixel 3 the right-most, regardless of the snake direction at that module.
